source: User-provided Waters Next Gen LC conference screenshots
scope: Conference and event websites to monitor for competitor launches, application themes, sponsor activity, posters, talks, abstracts, and workflow messaging.

events.audienceDescription: CMC/regulatory scientists from industry and agencies; regulatory-heavy forum.
events.monitoringUse: Track biologics characterization requirements and regulatory language that may change LC and LC-MS roadmap priorities.

events.eventName: SLAS 2026 (Society for Laboratory Automation and Screening)
events.audienceDescription: Lab automation, screening, assay development, informatics, biopharma R&D, vendors, startups.
events.monitoringUse: Monitor automation and informatics claims that influence LC workflow differentiation.

events.audienceDescription: Analytical quality leaders for mRNA characterization and control.
events.monitoringUse: Track LNP and RNA analytics requirements for LC-MS workflow prioritization.

events.audienceDescription: EU bioprocess development, scale-up, CMC, QC analytics; scientists and vendor partners.
events.monitoringUse: Monitor bioprocess analytics demand and competitor workflow messaging.

events.audienceDescription: Chemists across sub-disciplines; broad academic, industry, and student audience; large exposition.
events.monitoringUse: Track broad chemistry application themes and early methods that may become product requirements.

events.audienceDescription: Cross-industry lab technology and analytics professionals; instrument vendors; QC/QA; R&D.
events.monitoringUse: Monitor global instrument launches and competitor positioning in lab technology.

events.audienceDescription: ADC method development, characterization, QC/QA leaders; organizer pages describe technical CMC focus.
events.monitoringUse: Track ADC workflow requirements for biopharma LC-MS capability planning.

events.audienceDescription: Protein and antibody engineering; discovery and development; strong speaker faculty.
events.monitoringUse: Track biologics workflow themes and partnership/customer language.

events.audienceDescription: Oligo, peptide, mRNA, and genome editing pipeline from discovery to manufacturing.
events.monitoringUse: Monitor oligo, peptide, mRNA, and LNP analytical workflow signals.

events.eventName: ASGCT (American Society of Gene and Cell Therapy)
events.audienceDescription: Gene and cell therapy researchers, clinicians, bio-industry, regulators, patient advocates.
events.monitoringUse: Track emerging therapy areas that create analytical workflow pull.

events.eventName: SLAS EU (Society for Laboratory Automation and Screening)
events.audienceDescription: European lab automation, screening, informatics, and vendor ecosystem.
events.monitoringUse: Track European automation and informatics needs relevant to LC workflows.

events.audienceDescription: Waters customers and ASMS-adjacent users.
events.monitoringUse: Use as a Waters-owned customer signal source for LC-MS roadmap questions.

events.eventName: ASMS 2026 (American Society for Mass Spectrometry Annual Conference)
events.audienceDescription: Mass spectrometry scientists from academia, industry, and government; thousands of posters and hundreds of talks.
events.monitoringUse: Primary LC-MS competitor and application intelligence source.
events.refreshCadence: Daily during program and proceedings publication windows
events.accessType: Public conference and program pages; some planner content requires registration
events.whatToMeasure: Poster and oral titles by vendor and instrument, corporate breakfast seminars, repeated methods, new performance claims, and direct competitor comparisons.
events.whyItMatters: ASMS provides the densest annual view of vendor LC-MS proof, including head-to-head posters that may reveal competitive performance claims before formal product literature.
events.collectionDetail: 2 of 2 official conference/program endpoints reachable; this is endpoint coverage, not a poster count.

events.eventName: HPLC 2026 (International Symposium on High Performance Liquid Phase Separations and Related Techniques)
events.audienceDescription: Separation sciences researchers, vendors, and method developers across LC/HPLC/SFC/LC-MS.
events.monitoringUse: Primary LC and UHPLC technology trend source for Next Gen LC.
events.refreshCadence: Weekly; daily around abstract and program releases
events.whatToMeasure: Abstract and poster themes in dwell volume, dispersion, columns, multidimensional LC, hyphenated detection, method transfer, and vendor seminars.
events.whyItMatters: The HPLC series is the most direct scientific source for separation-performance and column-technology changes that can become LC product requirements.
events.collectionDetail: 2 of 2 official conference/program endpoints reachable; this is endpoint coverage, not a poster count.

events.audienceDescription: Metabolomics researchers across omics, bioinformatics, clinical, and environmental applications.
events.monitoringUse: Track omics application pull and informatics expectations.

events.eventName: ISSX EU (International Society for the Study of Xenobiotics)
events.audienceDescription: Drug metabolism, pharmacokinetics, toxicology, and xenobiotics researchers.
events.monitoringUse: Track DMPK/bioanalysis requirements that influence LC-MS product expectations.

events.audienceDescription: Bioprocess R&D, scale-up, quality, and analytics; industry and academia.
events.monitoringUse: Monitor analytics needs in bioprocessing and CMC workflows.

events.audienceDescription: Global MS community across fundamentals, instrumentation, life sciences, materials, environment, and energy.
events.monitoringUse: Track global mass spectrometry direction and competitor technology narratives.
events.refreshCadence: Weekly; daily during program and abstract publication windows
events.whatToMeasure: Instrument and acquisition advances, application-session concentration, vendor-authored posters, and repeated global MS workflow themes.
events.whyItMatters: IMSC adds a global, research-led view of MS direction that complements the vendor-heavy ASMS signal.
events.collectionDetail: 1 of 1 official conference/program endpoints reachable; this is endpoint coverage, not a poster count.

events.audienceDescription: Chemists across sub-disciplines; broad academic, industry, and student audience.
events.monitoringUse: Track chemistry and analytical methods that could create future workflow demand.

events.eventName: CASSS MS (Practical Applications of Mass Spectrometry)
events.audienceDescription: Applied MS for biopharma characterization, process monitoring, and release testing.
events.monitoringUse: Track high-specificity biopharma LC-MS use cases and QC expectations.

events.audienceDescription: R&D, digital, data, and ops leaders modernizing labs; informatics, automation, AI, culture.
events.monitoringUse: Track software and automation themes that shape LC ecosystem expectations.

events.eventName: MSACL 2026 (Mass Spectrometry & Advances in the Clinical Lab)
events.audienceDescription: Clinical laboratory scientists, translational researchers, assay developers, vendors, and laboratory directors applying mass spectrometry to patient care.
events.monitoringUse: Track LC-MS methods moving from discovery through translation into clinical availability.
events.refreshCadence: Weekly; daily during program and poster publication windows
events.accessType: Public conference, program, and poster pages
events.whatToMeasure: Poster counts by assay area and vendor, clinical-use status, validation claims, automation, turnaround time, and laboratory implementation barriers.
events.whyItMatters: MSACL separates early research from clinically available assays, providing direct evidence of what LC-MS workflows are approaching routine clinical use.
events.collectionDetail: 2 of 2 official conference/program endpoints reachable; this is endpoint coverage, not a poster count.

events.eventName: ISSX US (International Society for the Study of Xenobiotics)
events.audienceDescription: Drug metabolism, pharmacokinetics, toxicology, and xenobiotics researchers.
events.monitoringUse: Track DMPK and bioanalysis workflow needs for LC-MS roadmap implications.

events.audienceDescription: Pharmaceutical scientists across discovery to CMC; 300+ sessions and 270+ exhibitors.
events.monitoringUse: Track pharma CMC and bioanalysis trends that influence roadmap needs.

events.audienceDescription: EU sister event for oligonucleotide, peptide, and mRNA therapeutic scientists; pharma and biotech.
events.monitoringUse: Monitor European oligo, peptide, mRNA, and LNP analytical workflow signals.

events.eventName: RAFA (Symposium on Recent Advances in Food Analysis)
events.audienceDescription: Food analysis scientists, QA/QC labs, academic researchers, regulatory agencies.
events.monitoringUse: Track contaminant and food safety methods relevant to LC-MS/MS demand.

events.audienceDescription: EU protein and antibody engineering researchers; pharma and biotech R&D, analytics, process development.
events.monitoringUse: Track European biologics characterization and analytical workflow needs.

events.audienceDescription: Pharmaceutical, CRO, academic, technology, and regulatory scientists working in regulated bioanalysis.
events.monitoringUse: Track pre-competitive bioanalytical practice, regulatory interpretation, method validation, and emerging technology needs.
events.refreshCadence: Weekly; daily during agenda, abstract, and poster publication windows
events.accessType: Public meeting, agenda, and abstract-call pages; some materials are delegate-only
events.whatToMeasure: Repeated bioanalytical problems, modality-specific methods, validation and data-integrity discussions, sponsor presence, and LC-MS case-study themes.
events.whyItMatters: EBF provides industry-led evidence of regulated bioanalysis practice across pharma and CRO laboratories, including issues not visible in publication-volume data.
events.collectionDetail: 2 of 2 official conference/program endpoints reachable; this is endpoint coverage, not a poster count.

events.audienceDescription: Environmental toxicology and chemistry scientists, regulators, and industry researchers.
events.monitoringUse: Track environmental testing demand and regulatory method shifts.

events.eventName: IMSIS (International Mass Spectrometry Imaging Society Conference)
events.audienceDescription: Imaging scientists across modality R&D and translational informatics.
events.monitoringUse: Track adjacent MS imaging trends that may influence informatics and application positioning.
